outcomes: Familywise error: fraction of worlds with ANY qualification among agents whose population net Sharpe is at or below the common hurdle; denominator is every planned world.
Per-agent unconditional qualification and eligibility fractions with Wilson 95% Monte Carlo intervals; all abstentions remain in the denominator.
Per-agent rank histogram including an unscored category, top-rank frequency and strong-edge versus modest-edge rank recovery with coverage.
Every world seed, agent score, rank, p-value, qualification, eligibility and abstention reason; no seed exclusions or rerolls.
Unsupported stress scenarios reported separately as abstention checks, never evidence of valid p-values under dependence or reuse.
notes: Frozen before this calibration was executed. One fixed demonstration fixture had been smoke-tested during implementation; none of these world seeds had been evaluated.
Original synthetic Gaussian generator, independently specified. Known effects are stipulated; this is not market data, actual AI-agent trading, adoption, prospective evidence or proof of real skill.
Sessions are iid for supported cases; common Gaussian shocks correlate agents. The losing agent in mixed worlds is independent of peers. Correlation is not a score bonus.
Hypothetical gross returns add the known fee, which the evaluator subtracts once. Risk/positive-wealth and dependence-screen gates remain active; qualification probabilities include their effects.
Normal simple returns are a mathematical teaching model with unbounded support. Any out-of-contract generated path must stop and be reported, never resampled.
The common 0.05 per-period hurdle, 252 periods and 5% alpha are illustrative protocol choices, not universal economic cutoffs. Monte Carlo intervals quantify simulation uncertainty only.
No outcome-based tuning of generator, score, seeds, scenarios, costs, risk limits or reporting. Any correctness repair must be recorded and all worlds rerun.
